sentences.text: Hodie dies bonus est. Anna et Samuel in via ambulant.
sentences.english: Today is a good day. Anna and Samuel walk on the road.

sentences.text: Anna fessa non est. Hodie in valetudinario non laborat. Samuel quoque fessus non est.
sentences.english: Anna is not tired. Today she does not work at the clinic. Samuel is not tired either.

sentences.text: Quo imus, Anna?
sentences.english: Where are we going, Anna?
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Ad montem ambulamus. Mons non longe est.
sentences.english: We walk to the hill. The hill is not far.
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Ecce via! Via magna est.
sentences.english: Look, a road! The road is big.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Bona est. Veni mecum!
sentences.english: It is good. Come with me!
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Arbores magnae sunt. In arbore avis est. Avis cantat.
sentences.english: There are big trees. In the tree there is a bird. The bird sings.

sentences.text: Audi! Avis cantat.
sentences.english: Listen! The bird is singing.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Parva est, sed bene cantat. Arbor magna est.
sentences.english: It is small, but it sings well. The tree is big.
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Quid est hoc? Estne canis?
sentences.english: What is this? Is it a dog?
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Canis est. Ecce, in via est! Magnus est.
sentences.english: It is a dog. Look, it is on the road! It is big.
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Ille nos videt. Timeo!
sentences.english: It sees us. I am afraid!
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Canis bonus est. Ecce, ad nos venit.
sentences.english: The dog is good. Look, he comes to us.
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Nunc non timeo. Bonus est.
sentences.english: Now I am not afraid. He is good.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Samuel canem timet. Canis ad Annam et Samuelem venit. Anna canem amat.
sentences.english: Samuel is afraid of the dog. The dog comes to Anna and Samuel. Anna loves the dog.

sentences.text: Nunc ad montem ambulamus. Ecce aqua!
sentences.english: Now we walk to the hill. Look, water!
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Estne aqua ibi? Aquam bibere volo.
sentences.english: Is there water there? I want to drink water.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Aqua ibi est. Aqua bona est. Veni!
sentences.english: There is water there. The water is good. Come!
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Tandem ad montem veniunt. Ibi aquam bibunt. Aqua bona est.
sentences.english: At last they come to the hill. There they drink water. The water is good.

sentences.text: Ibi urbem vident. Urbs non magna est, sed bona est. Domus Marthae parva est. Ecclesia magna est.
sentences.english: There they see the town. The town is not big, but it is good. Martha's house is small. The church is big.

sentences.text: Ecce urbs! Omnia bona sunt.
sentences.english: Look, the town! All things are good.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Hodie dies bonus est. Gratias Deo ago.
sentences.english: Today is a good day. I give thanks to God.
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Et ego gratias Deo ago. Et tibi gratias ago, Anna.
sentences.english: And I give thanks to God. And I thank you, Anna.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Tandem ad urbem eunt. Samuel fessus est, sed bene valet. Anna quoque bene valet.
sentences.english: At last they go to the town. Samuel is tired, but he is well. Anna is well too.
